An ISO 9001:2015 Certified company

Legal Entity: Prefab Panel Nepal Pvt. Ltd.

Smart Panel (Prefab Panel Nepal Pvt. Ltd.) is an ISO 9001:2015 certified company and Nepal's premier manufacturer of high-performance EPS sandwich panels, solid panels, and EPS blocks. With an NPR 20 crore state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Bharatpur, Chitwan producing over 150,000 sq. ft. annually, we deliver lightweight, earthquake-ready, and energy-efficient building materials across all 77 districts of Nepal.
